name: Diepholz
notes: ADAC-Flugplatzrennen Diepholz, 1989-1991 layout (counter-clockwise): start/finish eastbound on runway 08/26, sweep north onto the curved northern taxiway, west past the aprons, long diagonal back to the runway's west end. Matched to the Wikimedia Commons layout diagram; the 1991 chicane positions are unverified and not modelled.
